Name: Phantom Assault
Description:
Lunge forward to deliver a two-hit combo.

Nullifies enemy attacks while lunging.

Name: Severing Abyss
Description: Jump high up and crash down in a powerful slam.

Name: Secret Art - Scissor Wind
Description: Create a vacuum vortex which can draw enemies in and slice them up.

Name: Secret Art - Forestall
Description: Swing your weapon to release a slash that can hit targets from midrange.

Name: Circulating Pulse
Description: Rush forward into a three-hit combo. Repeat the input during the attack to unleash a powerful finisher. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Circulating Pulse - Blink
Description: Rush forward into a three-hit combo. Repeat the input during the attack to perform a followup, then step backwards. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Energy Cleave
Description: Attach an energy blade to your weapon and perform a wide sweep in front of you.

Name: Energy Cleave - Twister
Description: Attach an energy blade to your weapon and perform a wide sweep all around you.

Name: Looming Slash
Description: Perform a slash while jumping into the air. Nullifies enemy attacks which land right before jumping.

Name: Thunderclap
Description: Unleash a slash of lightning before charging forward for another high-speed slash.

Name: Judgement Cutter
Description: Swing your weapon upward, releasing an energy slash.

Name: Fortress Stance
Description: Take a stance to deflect enemy attacks. Acts as a normal guard against attacks which cannot be deflected. Repeat the input while in the stance to step forward and perform a slash attack. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Coffin Breaker
Description: Perform a rapid, powerful slash at close range. Repeat the input to chain into a powerful smash. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Coffin Breaker - Sweeper
Description: Perform a rapid, powerful slash at close range. Repeat the input to chain into a swift side-slash. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Boosted Blade
Description:
Channel strength into an energy blade and strike downward.

Hold the input to increase reach and power.

Name: Boosted Blade - Horizon
Description: Channel strength into an energy blade and perform a horizontal slash. Hold the input to increase reach and power.

Name: Wraith's Fury
Description:
A combo attack that starts with a dashing slash.

Repeat the input to perform up to four consecutive attacks. (Each attack consumes ichor.)

Unleashes a powerful smash as the final combo attack.

Name: Wraith's Fury - Swift
Description:
A combo attack that starts with a dashing slash. Repeat the input to perform up to three consecutive attacks. (Each attack consumes ichor.)

Unleashes another dashing slash as the final combo attack.

Name: Vanquisher
Description: Perform a midrange slide to knock an enemy upward before slamming them back down.

Name: Unquenchable Flame
Description: Add fire damage to your weapon and assail nearby foes while calling up a pillar of fire.

Name: Mad Turbulence
Description: Spin your weapon to slash in all directions, attacking a wide area with energy blades.

Name: Flash Javelin
Description: Unleash a javelin of light with the thrust of your weapon.

Name: Flash Fleche
Description: Perform a long-range slide to pierce an enemy with your outheld weapon.

Name: Drill Breaker
Description: Drill into an enemy with a vortex of wind wrapped around your weapon. Repeat the input during the attack to chain into additional attacks. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Chariot Reave
Description: Perform a forward swipe to initiate a combo attack. Repeat the input during the initial attack to perform a second attack, then press or to perform a third attack. The third attack will differ based on the button pressed. (Each attack consumes ichor.)

Name: Chariot Reave - Blast
Description: Perform a forward swipe to initiate a combo attack. Repeat the input during the attack to perform up to three consecutive hits, launching a slash to finish. (Each attack consumes ichor.)

Name: Piercing Leap
Description: Jump up and thrust down from the air as you descend. Nullifies enemy attacks while jumping up.

Name: Piercing Leap - Tremor
Description: Jump up and thrust down from the air as you descend. Nullifies enemy attacks while jumping up. Repeat the input during the thrust descent to create a shock wave. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Heliosphere
Description:
Create a sun-like ball of energy. Repeat the input during the attack to pierce the ball with your weapon and cause it to explode. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Both the ball and explosion cause the status ailment sunblight to build up in enemies.

Name: Gaia Impact
Description:
Smash the ground, leap up, and slam down with an attack. 

The downward impact creates a shock wave, disrupting enemies in a wide area.

Name: Endless Onslaught
Description: Unleash powerful, continuous back-and-forth strikes. Repeat the input during the attack to continuously strike. Press to finish with a powerful strike. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Dive Bomb
Description: Leap forward and slam your weapon down to create a shock wave.

Name: Mighty Smash
Description: Raise your weapon over your head, then swing it with all your might. Hold the input to charge the attack and release to activate it. Higher charges deal greater damage.

Name: Backdraft
Description: Slam your weapon down, sending energy through it to create a shock wave, using its momentum to launch yourself backwards.

Name: Doomfall
Description:
Descend from midair to land a mighty blow. Creates a shock wave upon impact.

Can only be used while in midair.

Name: Power Shot
Description: Fire a powerful energy projectile. Knocks away any directly hit enemy.

Name: Drawback Shot
Description: Jump back swiftly while firing a three-shot energy burst.

Name: Spinning Rampage
Description: Perform a spinning slash with an extended energy blade. Shoots bullets of light as you spin.

Name: Fusillade Rondo
Description:
Rapidly fire three energy rounds with homing abilities.

Repeat the input during the attack to perform a finisher shot. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Trigger Rush
Description: Quickly dash forward and thrust your bayonet. Repeat the input during the attack to stop the dash and fire energy shots. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Heavenly Strike
Description: Launch energy into the sky to drop a pillar of light directly on top of your target.

Name: Glacial Barrage
Description: Create icy crystals which unleash a volley of frigid cold lasers.

Name: Shredding Spin
Description: Leap forward in a spinning slash which lands multiple hits.

Name: Scorpion
Description: Quickly jump back before rushing forward to stab with both blades. Nullifies enemy attacks while jumping back.

Name: Relentless Sword Dance
Description: Unleash rapid, continuous slashes. Repeat the input during the attack to continuously slash. Press to finish with a powerful strike. (Each attack consumes ichor.)

Name: Swift Blades
Description: Instantly dash a short distance and slash with dual blades. Press or during the attack to combo into a cut to the left or right. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Rising Twirl
Description: Perform a spinning slash that launches you into the air, allowing for follow-up aerial attacks.

Name: Shadow Slayer
Description:
Perform a diving slash from midair which nullifies all enemy attacks during descent.

Can only be used in midair.

Name: Whirling Shredder
Description: Combine two blades together and send them spinning rapidly forward like a rotary saw. User is left unarmed while blades remain spinning.

Name: Stalking Sabre
Description: Unleash a blade in front of you that pursues any enemy that it hits, continually applying damage. User is left unarmed while blade remains in pursuit.

Name: Orbital Blade
Description: Sends equipped blades spinning around the user, gradually increasing in range and mowing down anything in the area. User is left unarmed while blades remain spinning.

Name: Guillotine Kick
Description: Leap up high and land with a mighty kick while slamming down your weapon.

Name: Unshakable
Description: Take a stance to deflect enemy attacks. Acts as a normal guard against attacks which cannot be deflected. Repeat the input while in the stance to perform a palm attack. (Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Slicing Vortex
Description: Perform a flurry of acrobatic spinning kicks, slicing through your surroundings with your blades at the same time.

Name: Sonic Arrow
Description: Shoot a mini whirlwind.

Name: Blaze Shot
Description: Shoots a low-power fireball. Repeat the input during the attack to fire successive shots.

Name: Blazing Roar
Description: Launch blazing fireballs. Hold the input to charge for increased damage.

Name: Venomous Shot
Description: Unleash orbs that cause the status ailment venom to build up over time.

Name: Stun Shot
Description: Unleash orbs that cause the status ailment stun to build up over time.

Name: Draconic Stake
Description: Launch forward a massive stake made of blood.

Name: McLeish's Cog
Description: Unleash a cog symbolic of the Patientia Bloodline that causes intense bleeding. Cog can be stopped by repeating the input.

Name: Twilight
Description: Sends a beam of lightning shooting forward. Hold the input to continue the blast until you run out of ichor.

Name: Diamond Dust
Description: Shoot rapid-fire bursts of ice. Hold the input during the attack to continue barrage.

Name: Guard of Honor
Description: Launch multiple successive ice javelins at a target.

Name: Baba Yaga's Gaze
Description: Unleash a massive, bone-chilling ice shard.

Name: Bolt Blast
Description: Rapid-fire balls of lightning.

Name: Lightning Shower
Description: Generates pillars of lightning at multiple target locations.

Name: Blood Barrage
Description: Launches multiple blood stakes simultaneously. Hold the input to increase the number of stakes.

Name: Gatling Gun Organ
Description: Launches a barrage of spears of light in front of the user. Repeat the input during the attack to fire successive shots.

Name: Dazzling Prismatic Laser
Description: Blasts a wide area with a blinding beam of sunlight that causes the status ailment sunblight to build up over time.

Name: Satellite Saucer
Description: Launch a slashing disc of light at enemies. While a partner is present, the disc will travel back and forth between the user and partner.

Name: Lightning Chain
Description: Hits a target with a lightning strike that chains into and damages multiple enemies.

Name: Eschaton Crossing
Description: Creates a star-like ball of energy that spins around the user before finally exploding.

Name: Frost Wave
Description: Calls forth a frigid cold that spreads across the ground.

Name: Vorpal Flash
Description: Unleashes a flash of lightning from the user's hand to instantly scorch a target. Hold the input to charge for increased damage.

Name: Scorched Earth
Description: Creates a whirlwind of flames around the user. Hold the input to extend its duration.

Name: Ice Spikes
Description: Pierces a wide area with spikes of ice shooting up from the ground.

Name: Dusk Edge
Description: Create a blade of blood that sweeps through foes before you.

Name: Air Blast
Description: Releases a shock wave from the user's hand, which is highly efficient at breaking an enemy's guard.

Name: Bloody Impact
Description: Blast away nearby foes with a bloody shock wave.

Name: Elder Contract
Description: Causes a pillar of blood to erupt beneath a target.

Name: Firewall
Description: Creates a wall of flames in front of the user.

Name: Falling Sun
Description: Launch into the air before crashing down in explosive flames. Negates all enemy attacks while airborne.

Name: Graviton Core
Description:
Creates a small black hole that draws in enemies. Press the action button again to cause the black hole to explode.
(Consumes ichor on use.)

Name: Venomous Web
Description: Create a field at the target's feet that causes the status ailment venom to build up over time.

Name: Stun Web
Description: Create a field at the target's feet that causes the status ailment stun to build up over time.

Name: Adrenaline
Description: Temporarily boosts your attack power.

Name: Bridge to Glory
Description: Temporarily boosts Attack for you and your allies based on your Mind stat.

Name: Overdrive
Description: Temporarily boosts Attack for you and your allies. Effect ends when user takes damage.

Name: Blow of Madness
Description: Increases the power of the next attack by a fixed amount.

Name: Flashing Fang
Description: Increases the power of the next attack by an amount based on the user's stats.

Name: Merciless Reaper
Description: Ignores some of the enemy's defense and guarding for your next attack.

Name: Immortal Bane
Description: Temporarily makes attacks reduce more of an enemy's recoverable damage.

Name: Blade Dance
Description: Temporarily increases attack power each time you damage an enemy with your weapon.

Name: Warrior Spirit - Might
Description: Temporarily boosts your attack power. More effective the closer the enemy is.

Name: Ranged Impact
Description: Temporarily increases attack power for bayonets and certain bequeathed forma shots.

Name: Super Charge
Description: Temporarily boosts strength of attacks initiated by holding the input.

Name: Time Crunch
Description: Speeds up the charge time for charged attacks.

Name: Dark Shout
Description: Greatly increases the potency of the next magic forma you cast.

Name: Forma Prowess
Description: Temporarily increases magic forma speed for you and your partner.

Name: Risk Ignition
Description: Forma only usable when overburdened. Boosts attack power for a short time.

Name: Thirsting Blade
Description: Temporarily lowers the bleed factor caused by weapons and increases attack power.

Name: Out for Blood
Description: Temporarily deal more damage to enemies proportional to their bleed buildup. Enemy bleed gets reduced each time damage is dealt.

Name: Double Down
Description: Spends LP to boost attack power.

Name: Highlander
Description: Consumes all LP to temporarily boost attack power. Boost amount depends on the amount of LP consumed.

Name: Sacrificial Edge
Description: Greatly increases attack power, but gradually drains HP.

Name: Bloodsucking Blades
Description: Temporarily increases the bleed factor of weapon attacks for you and your partner.

Name: Hunting Feast
Description: Temporarily increases the bleed factor of weapon attacks.

Name: Heart Breaker
Description: Temporarily increases user's stagger attack power.

Name: Crushing Might
Description: Temporarily makes it easier to break an opponent's guard.

Name: Precision
Description: Temporarily makes it easier for you and your allies to disrupt enemies with weapons.

Name: Flame Weapon
Description: Temporarily adds fire damage to your current weapon.

Name: Frost Weapon
Description: Temporarily adds ice damage to your current weapon.

Name: Lightning Weapon
Description: Temporarily adds lightning damage to your current weapon.

Name: Blood Weapon
Description: Temporarily adds blood damage to your current weapon.

Name: Venom Mark
Description: Temporarily applies the status ailment venom to your current weapon.

Name: Warding Mark
Description: Temporarily applies the status ailment inhibit to your current weapon.

Name: Binding Mark
Description: Temporarily applies the status ailment stall to your current weapon.

Name: Numbing Mark
Description: Temporarily applies the status ailment stun to your current weapon.

Name: Fire Barrel
Description: Temporarily adds fire damage to bayonets and certain bequeathed forma shots.

Name: Ice Barrel
Description: Temporarily adds ice damage to bayonets and certain bequeathed forma shots.

Name: Lightning Barrel
Description: Temporarily adds lightning damage to bayonets and certain bequeathed forma shots.

Name: Blood Barrel
Description: Temporarily adds blood damage to bayonets and certain bequeathed forma shots.

Name: Iron Will
Description: Temporarily reduces all incoming damage.

Name: Foulblood Barrier
Description: Creates a single-use barrier around you and your partner that greatly reduces damage.

Name: Warrior Spirit - Rigor
Description: Temporarily reduces damage taken from enemy attacks. More effective the closer the enemy is.

Name: Ablative Blood
Description: Temporarily causes damage taken to be greatly reduced at the cost of ichor.

Name: Juggernaut
Description: Increases balance and resistance to enemy attacks, but lowers dodge effectiveness and elemental resistance.

Name: Defensive Order
Description: Temporarily lowers your attack power and increases defense for both you and your partner.

Name: Last Guard
Description: Receiving fatal damage when your LP is over a certain amount will leave you with 1 LP. Only applies once per activation.

Name: Healing Casket
Description: Consumes regeneration power when using formae and automatically regenerates when LP reaches 0.

Name: Feral Tenacity
Description: Receiving fatal damage when your HP is over a certain amount will leave you with 1 HP. Only applies once per activation.

Name: Circular Guard
Description: Temporarily guards against attacks from all directions when blocking with a shield.

Name: Steady Bulwark
Description: Temporarily increases guard defense against physical attacks.

Name: Prismatic Veil
Description: Temporarily increases guard defense against elemental attacks for you and your allies.

Name: Guard Stability
Description: Temporarily reduces the stamina cost of guarding.

Name: Concentration
Description: Temporarily makes it easier to deflect enemy attacks.

Name: Deft Deflection
Description: Temporarily reduces damage taken when deflecting enemy attacks and increases disruption resistance.

Name: Dogged Fighter
Description: Temporarily gain tolerance to incoming damage, increasing disruption resistance.

Name: Royal Heart
Description: Temporarily increases disruption resistance to enemy strikes while attacking.

Name: Perfect Balance
Description: Increases disruption resistance for you and your allies against a single enemy attack after forma use.

Name: Healing Counter
Description:
Temporarily adds the following effect to dodges and defensive formae for shields:

Slightly regenerates LP when an enemy attack is successfully dodged or guarded against.

Name: Charge-up Counter
Description:
Temporarily adds the following effect to defensive formae for shields:

Perfectly blocking enemy attacks boosts attack and stagger attack power.

Name: Bloodletting Counter
Description:
Temporarily adds the following effect to dodges and defensive formae for shields:

Fires bleed-inducing blades when an enemy attack is successfully dodged or guarded against.

Name: Guard Reversal
Description: Temporarily enables you to deflect enemy attacks and stagger them after guarding.

Name: Sly Vengeance
Description: For a limited time, taking damage generates fiery projectiles that attack the enemy.

Name: Countermeasure
Description: For a limited time, dodging enemy attacks generates projectiles that attack the enemy.

Name: Life Conversion
Description: Spends LP to restore HP.

Name: Elemental Wall
Description: Temporarily increases defense against all elemental attacks.

Name: Flame Protection
Description: Temporarily increases defense against fire.

Name: Ice Protection
Description: Temporarily increases defense against ice.

Name: Lightning Protection
Description: Temporarily increases defense against lightning.

Name: Blood Protection
Description: Temporarily increases defense against blood.

Name: Antibody Generation
Description: Temporarily increases resistance to all status ailments.

Name: Panacea's Essence
Description: Cures you and your partner of all status ailments, or blocks them if used before being afflicted.

Name: Venom Removal
Description: Cures you and your partner of the status ailment venom. Use to block the effect before being afflicted.

Name: Stun Removal
Description: Cures you and your partner of the status ailment stun. Can block the effect if used before being afflicted.

Name: Leak Removal
Description: Cures you and your partner of the status ailment leak. Can block the effect if used before being afflicted.

Name: Inhibit Removal
Description: Cures you and your partner of the status ailment inhibit. Can block the effect if used before being afflicted.

Name: Stall Removal
Description: Cures you and your partner of the status ailment stall. Can block the effect if used before being afflicted.

Name: Cleansing Light
Description: For a limited time, a portion of the damage you take after casting formae will slowly heal automatically.

Name: Regenerator
Description: Increases the amount restored from regeneration for you and your companions.

Name: Sturdy Body
Description: Temporarily lowers forma attack power and increases max LP.

Name: Focused Counter
Description:
Temporarily adds the following effects to dodges:

Reduces ichor consumption for all formae for a short time when an enemy attack is successfully dodged.

Name: Ichor Efficiency
Description: Temporarily reduces the ichor cost of weapon attacks.

Name: Supernatural Blood
Description: Enables you to consume HP instead of ichor to cast formae when you have insufficient ichor.

Name: Blood Sacrifice
Description: Spends your own HP to gain ichor.

Name: Ichor Regeneration
Description: Gradually restores ichor in exchange for a decrease in weapon attack power and defense.

Name: Rush Hour
Description: Temporarily boosts sprint speed.

Name: Hasten
Description: Temporarily enhances your dodges.

Name: Conservation
Description: Temporarily reduces stamina consumption. The effect ends if you take damage.

Name: Featherweight
Description: Temporarily reduces stamina costs for jumps and aerial attacks.

Name: Valiant Heart
Description: Reduces the stamina cost of dodging.

Name: Serene Stance
Description: Immediately take up a stance that calms your mind and restores all stamina.

Name: Morale Boost
Description: Temporarily increases the maximum stamina of you and your partner and fully restores both your stamina.

Name: Invigorating Rush
Description: Temporarily restores stamina when you successfully dodge enemy attacks.

Name: Red Shoes
Description: Enables you to consume LP and HP to perform actions when you have run out of stamina.

Name: Full Auto
Description: Temporarily gain the ability to shoot bayonets without reloading. Ammo costs still apply.

Name: Somatic Zeal
Description: Temporarily increases Strength and Dexterity.

Name: Cognitive Zeal
Description: Temporarily increases Mind and Willpower.

Name: Vigorous Zeal
Description: Temporarily increases Vitality and Fortitude.

Name: Liberator
Description: Temporarily reduces stat burden.

Name: Lone Wolf
Description: Temporarily disables partner summoning and assimilation to greatly reduce user's stat burden.

Name: Forma Extension
Description: Temporarily lengthens the effects of formae used by you and your partner.

Name: Focused Contamination
Description: Temporarily lengthens the duration of status ailments dealt to enemies by you and your partner.

Name: Soul Stimulant
Description: Temporarily boosts attack power of current partner.

Name: Overlink
Description: Temporarily activates assimilation effects while a partner is summoned. Cannot be used while partner is assimilated.

Name: Offensive Order
Description: Temporarily lowers your defense and increases attack power for both you and your partner.

Name: Nightstalker
Description: Reduces the amount of sound you create, making it more difficult for enemies to detect you.

Name: Gluttonous Urge
Description: Accelerates your metabolism to reset the effects of food.

Name: Floating Light
Description: Creates a ball of light at your feet.
